Name: Star Wars: Battle for Hoth
Description: Defend the Rebel base on the ice planet Hoth from the Empire's onslaught in this tower-defence game. Build and upgrade towers, command X-wings and bring down the AT-ATs before they overrun your shield generator.

Achievements.Name: Classic Total Victory
Achievements.Description: Complete all levels Classic/Easy/Wipe Them Out

Achievements.Name: Classic Absolute Victory
Achievements.Description: Complete all levels Classic/Normal/Wipe Them Out

Achievements.Name: Fortress Total Victory
Achievements.Description: Complete all levels Fortress/Easy/Wipe Them Out

Achievements.Name: Fortress Absolute Victory
Achievements.Description: Complete all levels Fortress/Normal/Wipe Them Out

Achievements.Name: Power-up!
Achievements.Description: Build Tower and Power Generator to supply it

Achievements.Name: X-wing Ace
Achievements.Description: Kill 10 TIE Fighters using X-wing fighters.

Achievements.Name: Commander of Technology

Achievements.Name: Wipe Them Out – Again!

Achievements.Name: Logistics Award
